title: Statement Delivery Charges Across the Personal Checking Tiers
content:
Where statement delivery on a Personal Checking account is paper at cycle close, the tier's paper statement fee applies for that statement cycle. Primary owners who are at least the exempt age in whole years at cycle close pay no paper statement fee whatever the tier's figure.

| Tier | Paper statement fee per statement cycle (USD) | Age at which the primary owner is exempt (whole years) |
|---|---|---|
| Access Checking | 0.00 | 65 |
| Student Checking | 0.00 | 65 |
| Everyday Checking | 2.00 | 65 |
| Interest Checking | 2.00 | 65 |
| Premier Checking | 0.00 | 65 |
| Private Client Checking | 0.00 | 65 |

A figure of 0.00 means the tier carries no paper statement fee, so the exempt age changes nothing for owners of that tier.

**Basis Q and A.**

*On which tiers does the exempt age make a practical difference?* Only on Everyday Checking and Interest Checking, the two tiers whose paper statement fee stands above zero at 2.00. An owner of either tier who is 65 or older at cycle close pays nothing for paper delivery; an owner who is 64 at cycle close pays 2.00 for that cycle.
